item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
JazzDeinterlacer 1.1

  • Real-time playback — a RAM cache and master-clock engine play even QTGMC at full speed; JKL shuttle (2×/4×/8×), forward and reverse play with audio.
  • Before / After Wipe — compare source and result in one viewer with a draggable divider, during play or frame-by-frame.
  • Comb-Detector Sensitivity — one slider that cleans up residual interlace lines on slow or noisy areas, shared by every algorithm.
  • Pixel-aspect (PAR) correction — 1:1 / 4:3 / 16:9 display for SD tape sources.
  • QTGMC detail recovery and a working Smoothing control.
  • Customisable keyboard shortcuts and Open Last (⌘⇧O).
  • Frame-stepping now matches playback for every algorithm; source audio starts instantly across sessions; DV/AVI fixes.
